panels.description: A Halyard worker submits a repaired filtration component at a public contribution kiosk. Keep the upper kiosk clear.
The kiosk assigns ownership to Caldera House and displays a creator bonus while the worker's face remains visible beside it. Keep the upper display clear.
Alex and Ada open Adrian's public registry entry in a House archive. Keep the upper screen clear.
Alex and Ada face the locked registry display in the technical district. Keep the upper screen clear.
